action_summary: Made 'the Perfect Algorithm' real: one generic loop for any arbitrary environment that scans observed facts (affordance graph + observations), asks the right question (the action whose trial most reduces what is unknown; closeness only when the env supports snapshot/restore and a heuristic exists), retrieves from memory what is known, fetches external instant knowledge (completeness-gated, off by default), plans the shortest way over the learned model, acts and verifies the goal is observed, generalizes from the ONE verified experience (the goal family + plan sketch + scope + evidence hash — never the raw trace as knowledge), admits the generalization on fresh instances it was not taught on, persists priors (observed facts) unconditionally and admitted rules (hypotheses) only on admission, and replays admitted plan rules instantly on a repeat goal. Also added a specialist code-repair path: anti-unified rule -> admission gate -> persist on ADMIT -> fresh-defect replay. Reuses environment_learning, jit_knowledge, the anti-unifier and the admission gate; no new runtime dependency. Authority: NONE.

agent_orientation.earlier_routes_exhausted_reason: The repo already contains the scan (environment_learning), the instant-knowledge fetch (jit_knowledge), the anti-unification (verified_skill_crystallizer), the admission gate (lesson_admission_gate) and the skill library; the missing mechanism is the loop that composes them. Duplicating any of those pieces would add a second implementation of the same mechanism, which the laws forbid; so the route is REUSE+COMPOSE, not SYNTHESIZE_NEW_PRIMITIVE.
agent_orientation.independent_verification_note: Producer-run sandbox only: 18 tests (unit + integration, 3 code-repair specialist tests), one generic-loop receipt (plan 6 on a held-out 4x4 grid, priors persisted, rule refused honestly), one code-repair admission receipt (ADMIT on unseen victims, fresh-defect replay PASS). No independent identity re-ran any of this.
